sections.title: Love and Work: Race, Sex, and Class in America
sections.description: This is an introduction to literary study through a survey of works from a specific historical period. This course is ideal for students wishing to explore a significant era, and it presents a range of texts and contexts for understanding the cultural products of a period. See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of the current offerings.
